description: Ministry of Defence - The name list of Air Force Personnel been pleased to award the Videsha Seva Padakkama
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the awarding of the Videsha Sewa Padakkama (Foreign Service Medal) to specific named Air Force personnel by the President. It contains a detailed list of individuals with their service numbers, ranks, and names, but does not include any detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes. This fits the definition of Type 2 (People Gazette) as it focuses exclusively on personnel recognition/awards without detailing their specific duties or responsibilities.
